decisions.reason: As a recently launched adjacent product for an established machinery supplier, its market value is still uncertain and the cost of keeping this option open for another year is likely modest.
The centrifuge is somewhat more specialized and may require more commercial support, but after only one year there is still too little evidence to justify abandonment.
Coolant nozzles are a simple complementary product that is inexpensive to continue offering, so real-options logic favors waiting for more demand information.
This conveyor fits the firm's core industrial handling range, and a large established German manufacturer would typically keep such a new line on the market while uncertainty resolves.
The magnetic belt variant broadens the product family and likely shares capabilities with existing offerings, making continued market presence a low-cost option.
The hinged belt conveyor is a close-to-core extension, and with no clear negative signal yet the firm would rationally preserve the option rather than exit quickly.
